objective: First real, reproducible, cross-runtime EXL3 baseline on the supplied RTX 3060 12 GB VM. Trustworthy compatibility and performance data, not four bars on a graph.

benchmark.resolution_note: The campaign spec names PRADIUM-RUNTIME-BENCH-v1. The repository's frozen identity is PRADIUM-RUNTIME-BENCH-v2: the VERSION file read PRADIUM-RUNTIME-BENCH-v1 at commit 32ecc1f (its first commit) and was bumped to v2 at HEAD commit cf4e875, whose subject is 'Fix benchmark cache fairness, timing, deadlines and batch accounting'. v2 is the version-bumped successor of v1 and contains genuine measurement-fairness fixes, so the campaign freezes on the committed HEAD. No benchmark definition, prompt, length, warmup count, run count or metric formula was modified.

hardware.container_note: Unprivileged Docker container, not a full VM: no Docker-in-Docker, no kernel modules. This is why the trellis-serve published image could not be used directly.

tensor_layout.note: Standard exllamav3 EXL3 linear tensor group. quantization_config.json is produced by exllamav3/conversion/quant_config.py (create_quantization_config_json), i.e. it is an exllamav3-native artifact, not a third-party format.

exllamav3.role: Runtime A - native/reference EXL3 execution path
exllamav3.install: upstream prebuilt wheel exllamav3-1.5.3+cu128.torch2.10.0-cp312-cp312-linux_x86_64.whl (matches pinned tag; Python 3.12 / torch 2.10.0 / CUDA 12.8)

sglang_exl3.role: Runtime B - EXL3 path on NVIDIA Ampere

headline_blocker.issue: The supplied VM's NVIDIA driver (550.144.03, CUDA 12.4) cannot execute a CUDA 13 runtime, so the pinned SGLang 0.5.20 and vLLM 0.30.0 stacks cannot run here.
headline_blocker.evidence_1: SGLang 0.5.20 hard-pins torch==2.13.0; vLLM 0.30.0 hard-pins torch==2.13.0.
headline_blocker.evidence_2: torch==2.13.0 on PyPI is a CUDA 13.0 build: requires cuda-toolkit[...]==13.0.3, nvidia-cudnn-cu13==9.20.0.48, nvidia-nccl-cu13, nvidia-nvshmem-cu13, cuda-bindings>=13.0.3.
headline_blocker.evidence_3: torch 2.13.0 has no CUDA 12 build on any PyTorch index (cu126/cu128/cu129 newest is 2.9.1), so no CUDA 12 path exists for those pins.
headline_blocker.evidence_4: Direct runtime probe: loading the CUDA 13 runtime reports cudaRuntimeGetVersion = 13.0 while cudaDriverGetVersion = 12.4, and cudaSetDevice(0) returns 35 (cudaErrorInsufficientDriver, 'CUDA driver version is insufficient for CUDA runtime version').
headline_blocker.evidence_5: The VM is an unprivileged container, so the host driver cannot be upgraded, and the trellis-serve published Docker image ghcr.io/0xsero/sglang-exl3:v0.7.0-ampere cannot be used because Docker-in-Docker is unavailable.
headline_blocker.consequence: Runtime B and Runtime C are recorded as INSTALL_FAILURE with the driver/CUDA-major mismatch as the cause. This is a property of the supplied environment, NOT a finding about EXL3 support in SGLang or vLLM, and NOT about MiniCPM5.

key_findings: Decode throughput falls 109.9 -> 79.2 tok/s from SS to LL while the ITL MEDIAN stays within 7.89-8.98 ms; the loss is entirely in the tail (ITL p99 20.69 -> 69.09 ms).
Prefill throughput rises with prompt length (2106 tok/s at 128 tokens, ~5070 at 2048) then falls (3333 at 16384): short prompts are launch/overhead dominated.

Concurrency reaches only 50-74% of ideal 8x scaling at C8, with per-request decode at 40-74% of C1, while GPU utilisation drops to 44.9% and power to 65.8 W on the SS profile: the limiter is host-side work on 2 physical cores, not VRAM or kernels.
The 32768-token context point cannot fit a 32768-token KV pool (needs 130 pages of 128) and is refused by the runtime; the model itself supports 131072.
GPU is never the binding constraint: <=3 GB of 12 GB VRAM, 65-92% utilisation, 113-152 W of 170 W, 50-73 C.

coverage.context: 7/8 lengths valid under the official 32768-token pool; CTX-32768 FAILED on pool sizing and is additionally measured at 49152 tokens as a labelled supplementary run (10/10 SUCCESS)
coverage.prefix_cache: 6 ratios x 3 scenarios, 1440 records, 0 failures; cross_session control flat at 4475-4487 tok/s at every ratio
coverage.scheduler: 3 resident decoders + 1 large prefill; ITL 14.62 ms -> 329.95 ms during prefill, 499.69 ms max stall, full recovery
coverage.batching: B1/B2/B4/B8 at MM, 165 records; B8 = 5.65x B1
coverage.startup: model load 1561.78 ms, cold first request TTFT 1574.01 ms, warm TTFT 11.27 ms median (re-load path; see report caveat)
coverage.soak: 30 min, 170 iterations, 0 failures, VRAM +3.86 MB, RAM +36.54 MB, TTFT -7.9%, throughput +3.7%

supplementary_configuration.reason: CTX-32768 (32768 input + 256 output = 33024 tokens = 130 pages) does not fit the official 32768-token KV pool (128 pages) and is refused by the runtime
supplementary_configuration.note: different runtime configuration, labelled as such everywhere; the official 32768-token result is kept as FAILED and is not overwritten
